theme.name: Superhero
theme.style: Bold superhero comic-book collectible-card key art, drawn as a full-bleed splash-page illustration: heavy confident ink outlines, dynamic foreshortened staging, halftone-dot shading over punchy four-color flats, the way a landmark issue paints its cover moment. Hot crimson key light rakes the subject from one side, a hard electric-yellow rim light separates it from a deep indigo night-city darkness, and speedline energy and rooftop haze fall away behind. One strong centered focal shape, isolated, uncluttered edges, nothing in the background competing with it, and it still reads at thumbnail size. Square composition with generous breathing room. The art is full-bleed and fills the entire square to every edge, the scene cut off by the picture edges on all four sides: no border, no margin, no matting, no panel gutter, no drawn edge line, no vignette box, no rounded corners. Artwork only: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no readable symbols, no UI labels, no card frame, no speech bubbles, no caption boxes, no sound-effect lettering.

C.prompt: Context. A rooftop crime-board under a single work lamp, the case pinned and threaded across it, one cone of light defining exactly what is known while the skyline beyond falls to darkness.
C.alt: Superhero illustration for the Context letter of the CRAFT acronym.
C.bio: The case as it actually stands: what is pinned inside the lamplight, and the dark past its edge.

R.prompt: Role. A line of silhouetted heroes on a rooftop ledge at night, one stepping forward into a hot spotlight, cape and gauntlets catching the beam.
R.alt: Superhero illustration for the Role letter of the CRAFT acronym.
R.bio: One hero called down from the ledge, because this job needs exactly their powers.

A.prompt: Action. The moment of commitment: a hero mid-leap between rooftops, launch debris and speedlines trailing behind, the whole frame driving one decisive forward vector.
A.alt: Superhero illustration for the Action letter of the CRAFT acronym.
A.bio: The leap is taken. Everything after this is momentum.

F.prompt: Format. A gadget press stamping raw glowing alloy into one exact tool, the die lifting to reveal a clean finished shape still hot at the edges.
F.alt: Superhero illustration for the Format letter of the CRAFT acronym.
F.bio: The answer arrives shaped for the hand that has to use it.

T.prompt: Target audience. A single citizen at an apartment window at night, lit from the front by a signal beacon sweeping the clouds, the whole scene built around who the signal is for.
T.alt: Superhero illustration for the Target audience letter of the CRAFT acronym.
T.bio: The beacon is not for the city. It is for the one window that understands it.

researcher.prompt: A masked investigator in the records vault beneath the precinct, reconstructing a charred case file, evidence threads and pinned photos orbiting her gloves as she follows one lead to its source.
researcher.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Researcher role.
researcher.bio: The cape is for rooftops. The real superpower is the filing system.

analyst.prompt: A mission-control tactician standing inside a suspended lattice of case data, pulling two conflicting feeds apart with both hands until the pattern between them resolves, outliers burning hottest.
analyst.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Analyst role.
analyst.bio: He sees the crime wave as a shape. Then he names the shape.

strategist.prompt: A team leader over a glowing tactical map of the city, three strike routes arcing across the boroughs, one hand hovering to commit while the alternates dim.
strategist.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Strategist role.
strategist.bio: Every plan survives until the first explosion. Hers survive the second.

historian.prompt: A veteran keeper in a hall of retired suits and trophies, drawing one luminous timeline thread out of the memorial archive, the older eras dimmer and deeper behind.
historian.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Historian role.
historian.bio: Every mask that came before hangs in his hall, and he knows why each one fell.

fact-checker.prompt: A sharp-eyed detective holding a suspect claim under a signal lamp, verification beams running from it toward distant evidence lockers, some locking solid and others flickering out.
fact-checker.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Fact-checker role.
fact-checker.bio: Rumors do not testify in her precinct. Receipts do.

synthesizer.prompt: A comms hero at a rooftop dispatch rig, braiding many scattered radio threads into one coherent signal cable, the crossed wires left standing visibly apart.
synthesizer.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Synthesizer role.
synthesizer.bio: Twelve sirens, one story. He finds it.

explainer-educator.prompt: An academy instructor unfolding a hero gadget into a floating exploded diagram above the training mat, pieces separating along clean yellow guide-lines, one hand steadying the lesson.
explainer-educator.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Explainer / Educator role.
explainer-educator.bio: Powers are easy. She teaches the part where you understand them.

comparative-reviewer.prompt: A grizzled gear-master between two suspended prototype suits in the armory, stress beams probing both, hairline weaknesses glowing where each will fail first.
comparative-reviewer.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Critical Reviewer role.
comparative-reviewer.bio: Both suits are marvelous. He will tell you which one gets you killed.

developer.prompt: A gadgeteer elbow-deep in an open utility rig, seating one new module into the harness while the surrounding tech lights up to accept it.
developer.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Developer role.
developer.bio: The suit is never finished. That is the point of the suit.

technical-troubleshooter.prompt: A field engineer tracing a fault arc through a downed mech's exposed spine by torchlight, one dark break in the glowing circuit, probe steady at the exact point of failure.
technical-troubleshooter.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Technical Troubleshooter role.
technical-troubleshooter.bio: When the tech dies at midnight, she is the one it confesses to.

systems-designer.prompt: An architect hero inside a hovering model of the team headquarters, moving whole wings and hangars into relation, power lines and escape routes drawn as light between them.
systems-designer.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Systems Designer role.
systems-designer.bio: He designs the base, the backup base, and the argument for both.

workflow-architect.prompt: A logistics chief above a glowing conveyor of mission crates, rerouting a stalled lane so the flow runs clean, the old bottleneck dark and bypassed beside it.
workflow-architect.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Workflow Architect role.
workflow-architect.bio: Heroes save the day. She makes sure the day arrives on schedule.

ux-ui-advisor.prompt: A suit engineer testing a gauntlet's controls on a hero's fist, heat-bloom showing where the grip fights the hand, a cleaner layout ghosted over the old one.
ux-ui-advisor.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the UX / UI Advisor role.
ux-ui-advisor.bio: If you fumble the trigger at three in the morning, that is his failure, not yours.

data-analyst.prompt: A data-hero suspended in a drifting particle field of incident reports, cupping the cluster where the pattern concentrates, stray noise dimming at the edges.
data-analyst.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Data Analyst role.
data-analyst.bio: The city talks in numbers. She is fluent.

qa-test-engineer.prompt: A trials operator deliberately driving a new suit past its limits in a reinforced testing hall, the exact failure point flaring bright as the plating gives.
qa-test-engineer.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the QA / Test Engineer role.
qa-test-engineer.bio: He breaks it on Tuesday so it holds on Saturday.

security-reviewer.prompt: A shadow-tester probing the headquarters shield grid from outside, one hairline seam lighting up under her probe, the rest of the wall holding dark and solid.
security-reviewer.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Security Reviewer role.
security-reviewer.bio: She breaks into the base every week. That is why nobody else ever has.

writer.prompt: A rooftop chronicler at a small desk above the city, drawing one clean line of luminous story-thread out of the raw noise below, finished strands hanging in ordered rows behind.
writer.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Writer role.
writer.bio: The city happens all at once. He writes it down one true line at a time.

editor.prompt: A copy chief over a story slab with a precision blade, lifting away excess in clean slivers, the strong spine of the piece left standing and lit.
editor.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Editor role.
editor.bio: Kills darlings faster than any villain. The story thanks her.

copywriter.prompt: A signal-hero tuning a rooftop broadcast dish down to one sharp focused beam, the wide scattered transmission collapsing into a single bright lance aimed downtown.
copywriter.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Copywriter role.
copywriter.bio: One message, one target, no collateral.

rewriter.prompt: A forge-hero melting a dented piece of armor and recasting it in a cleaner die, the original silhouette ghosted in the steam so its purpose survives the remake.
rewriter.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Rewriter role.
rewriter.bio: Same metal, cleaner lines, nothing lost but the dents.

pitch-strategist.prompt: An advocate at the front of a darkened council chamber, raising a rising arc of light from problem to proof, thrown objection-bolts shattering against it as it climbs.
pitch-strategist.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Pitch Strategist role.
pitch-strategist.bio: Funding for the team, one bulletproof argument at a time.

presentation-slide-structurer.prompt: A briefing officer sequencing floating mission panels into one ordered run above the table, each panel holding a single clear shape, the line receding into the dark.
presentation-slide-structurer.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Presentation Designer role.
presentation-slide-structurer.bio: Nobody leaves her briefings confused. Some leave inspired.

creative-director.prompt: A visions director at a projection rig casting several genuinely different hero silhouettes at once, each distinct in its own light, one hand raised toward the boldest.
creative-director.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Creative Director role.
creative-director.bio: Capes, colors, silhouettes: she decides what hope looks like from a rooftop.

concept-developer.prompt: A concept-smith growing a raw spark of an idea into a structured core inside a containment chamber, the hook crystallizing hard and bright at its center.
concept-developer.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Concept Developer role.
concept-developer.bio: Every legend starts as a loose spark. He teaches it to hold a shape.

brainstorming-partner.prompt: A speedster mid-blur around a workshop table, leaving a trail of dozens of distinct glowing prototype shapes hovering in the air, the strongest few already drifting together.
brainstorming-partner.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Brainstorming Partner role.
brainstorming-partner.bio: A hundred ideas before breakfast. Three survive lunch. That is the job.

prompt-engineer.prompt: A mission-scripter tuning a glowing directive core at a control bench, ambiguity venting off as dark smoke while the order settles into a clean stable pulse.
prompt-engineer.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Prompt Engineer role.
prompt-engineer.bio: Vague orders get sidekicks hurt. His never are.

tutor.prompt: A patient trainer guiding a young hero's hand to the next rung of a ladder of light up a training tower, the climbed rungs still glowing warm below.
tutor.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Tutor role.
tutor.bio: She never lifts you. She makes the next rung obvious.

curriculum-designer.prompt: An academy dean laying a sequenced path of training platforms across a dark hangar, each platform locking into the last, checkpoint beacons marking mastery.
curriculum-designer.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Curriculum Designer role.
curriculum-designer.bio: From first push-up to first rescue, in the only order that works.

mentor.prompt: A retired legend beside a rookie on a high rooftop ledge, pointing out one specific route through the streets below rather than the whole skyline.
mentor.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Mentor role.
mentor.bio: Hung up the cape. Kept the map.

consultant.prompt: A fixer at a crowded case table, sweeping the clutter aside to leave one clearly lit course of action, the discarded options dimmed at the table's edge.
consultant.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Consultant role.
consultant.bio: Says the one sentence the whole team was avoiding. Worth every penny.

product-strategist.prompt: An operations strategist weighing glowing mission-opportunities on a suspended balance, one pan clearly heavier and lit, the rejected mass set aside in shadow.
product-strategist.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Product Strategist role.
product-strategist.bio: The team cannot save every block tonight. She decides which one, and owns it.

market-positioning-advisor.prompt: A territory analyst planting a beacon-marker into open unclaimed ground on a glowing city map, rival markers clustered thick elsewhere in the grid.
market-positioning-advisor.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Positioning Strategist role.
market-positioning-advisor.bio: Every hero guards downtown. He found the neighborhood nobody watches.

product-manager.prompt: A mission coordinator triaging a queue of incoming alerts, pulling three forward into the lit response lane and holding the rest behind a barrier.
product-manager.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Product Manager role.
product-manager.bio: Three sirens get answered now. The rest get answered right.

summarizer.prompt: A debrief officer feeding a tower of mission footage into a compression rig and drawing out one dense luminous chip that holds all of its weight.
summarizer.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Summarizer role.
summarizer.bio: Six hours of chaos, one line that tells command what mattered.

organizer.prompt: An armory keeper standing amid drifting unsorted gear, snapping each piece into a glowing rack lattice, the empty slots left visibly dark.
organizer.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Organizer role.
organizer.bio: Every gadget in its slot, and the missing grapple loudly obvious.

context-scope.prompt: A rooftop searchlight throwing a bounded pool of light onto the dark streets below, its clean edge marking exactly how far the job extends, everything beyond staying night.
context-scope.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the context-scope modifier lineage.
context-scope.bio: The beam decides how much city this job is. Outside the pool is somebody else's shift.

context-evidence.prompt: An evidence board of pinned exhibits with taut threads running up to the claim they support, the weakest threads visibly thinner.
context-evidence.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the context-evidence modifier lineage.
context-evidence.bio: The board does not care what feels true. It cares what the thread holds.

context-constraints.prompt: Heavy containment clamps closed around a glowing energy core, hard immovable jaws holding the shape in, softer preference-markers resting loose outside them.
context-constraints.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the context-constraints modifier lineage.
context-constraints.bio: The clamps are not the enemy of the power. They are why the block is still standing.

context-assumptions.prompt: A building frame propped by translucent holographic girders among the real steel, the load-bearing projections pulsing with warning light to show what falls if they are wrong.
context-assumptions.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the context-assumptions modifier lineage.
context-assumptions.bio: Some of these girders are guesses wearing hard hats. The pulsing ones carry the roof.

context-success.prompt: A training-range target with its acceptance gauge locking into the green, the exact tolerance ring visible and the failure zone marked dark beyond it.
context-success.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the context-success modifier lineage.
context-success.bio: Done means the gauge says done. Heroics that miss the ring are just property damage.

context-exclusions.prompt: A barricade checkpoint splitting incoming traffic, diverting one lane cleanly away into a sealed dark tunnel while the approved flow continues lit.
context-exclusions.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the context-exclusions modifier lineage.
context-exclusions.bio: What gets waved through matters less than what gets turned around. The checkpoint remembers both.

action-inspect.prompt: A detective's magnifying lens hovering over a disassembled device, sweeping its beam across the parts and catching one loose connection glinting out of alignment.
action-inspect.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the action-inspect modifier lineage.
action-inspect.bio: The lens has ended more schemes than any punch. It simply will not look away.

action-analyze.prompt: A forensics column pulling a single mixed sample apart into distinct luminous strata, causes settling into layered bands, one anomalous band burning brighter.
action-analyze.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the action-analyze modifier lineage.
action-analyze.bio: Mix lies together long enough and they layer. The bright band is where the truth floats.

action-compare.prompt: A steel lab balance suspended in the dark holding two devices against the same measuring beam, the tipping difference clearly readable in its tilt.
action-compare.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the action-compare modifier lineage.
action-compare.bio: Two contenders, one beam, no applause. The tilt is the verdict.

action-create.prompt: A workshop gantry arm assembling a finished gadget out of drifting component parts, the device taking shape in a bloom of hot construction light.
action-create.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the action-create modifier lineage.
action-create.bio: Somewhere between the parts bin and the bloom of light, it becomes a thing with a purpose.

action-recommend.prompt: A rail-yard switch committing to one of several branching tracks, the chosen line lighting up bright and continuous while the others go dark.
action-recommend.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the action-recommend modifier lineage.
action-recommend.bio: The switch does not hedge. Trains cannot ride two tracks.

action-verify.prompt: A gauntlet of scanner gates running a finished gadget down the line, each gate lighting as it passes, one gate still probing hard.
action-verify.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the action-verify modifier lineage.
action-verify.bio: Every gate it clears is a promise kept. The one still glowing is a promise pending.

action-summarize.prompt: An industrial compactor reducing a tall stack of case material into one dense bright chip, the original volume ghosted behind at its true scale.
action-summarize.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the action-summarize modifier lineage.
action-summarize.bio: The tower goes in. The chip comes out. Command reads the chip.

action-research.prompt: A rooftop sweep dish fanning search beams over the dark city, one distant return pinging bright while weaker returns fade.
action-research.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the action-research modifier lineage.
action-research.bio: The city always answers. The dish is for hearing which answer is load-bearing.

action-plan.prompt: A heist-board timeline of mission markers laid in ordered sequence, dependency lines drawn between them, the next step lit and the blocked ones dimmed.
action-plan.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the action-plan modifier lineage.
action-plan.bio: Every great save looks improvised. The board knows better.

action-ideate.prompt: An idea reactor coil throwing off many genuinely different energy forms at once, no two alike, a few of the strongest already drifting together into a cluster.
action-ideate.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the action-ideate modifier lineage.
action-ideate.bio: The coil's only rule: no duplicates. Volume first, judgment later.

action-explain.prompt: A holo-table exploding a gadget into floating parts along clean yellow guide-lines, the workings between the pieces becoming visible as they separate.
action-explain.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the action-explain modifier lineage.
action-explain.bio: It looks like magic until the table opens it up. Then it looks like a Tuesday.

action-clarify.prompt: A signal flare hovering at a gap in the case-board, its light outlining the exact shape of the missing piece rather than filling it in.
action-clarify.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the action-clarify modifier lineage.
action-clarify.bio: The flare marks what the team does not know yet. Answering it is cheaper than guessing.

format-info-card.prompt: A single clean steel slab standing alone in the dark, its face flat and plainly lit, no ornament and nothing stacked around it.
format-info-card.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the format-info-card modifier lineage.
format-info-card.bio: One panel, one answer, zero ceremony.

format-key-points.prompt: A rack of distinct batons and throwing tools standing in a row, each one separate and evenly lit, clear dark gaps holding them apart.
format-key-points.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the format-key-points modifier lineage.
format-key-points.bio: Grab any one and it works alone. That is what makes it a key point.

format-summary.prompt: A lab flask with the glowing concentrate settled at the very top and the supporting sediment layered below it in shadow.
format-summary.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the format-summary modifier lineage.
format-summary.bio: The top line is the mission. The sediment is the proof it happened.

format-sections.prompt: A cutaway skyscraper of stacked floors, each floor a distinct sealed volume with its own internal glow, the divisions between them crisp.
format-sections.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the format-sections modifier lineage.
format-sections.bio: Every floor has one purpose. The elevator is for readers in a hurry.

format-evidence.prompt: A floating claim slab held by taut cables to sealed evidence vaults below, each cable lit along its length, one unanchored slab drifting loose.
format-evidence.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the format-evidence modifier lineage.
format-evidence.bio: If it is not cabled to a vault, it is a rumor with good posture.

format-comparison.prompt: Several prototype devices mounted along shared measuring struts on a compact lab rig, the joints where they diverge flaring brighter, the rig ending well inside the picture.
format-comparison.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the format-comparison modifier lineage.
format-comparison.bio: Put them on the same struts and the arguing stops on its own.

format-next.prompt: A row of launch bays with ready-markers lit in sequence, the first primed and glowing hot, the later ones waiting cooler down the line.
format-next.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the format-next modifier lineage.
format-next.bio: Bay one launches now. The rest hold their heat until called.

format-length.prompt: A hydraulic caliper clamped around a bar of luminous alloy, compressing it to an exact marked width, the trimmed excess venting away as vapor.
format-length.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the format-length modifier lineage.
format-length.bio: Exactly to spec, not a millimeter of padding. The vents carry off the rest.

format-tiers.prompt: A hangar podium of descending platforms, the top platform small and brilliantly lit, each lower level wider and dimmer with supporting depth.
format-tiers.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the format-tiers modifier lineage.
format-tiers.bio: Headline on top, footnotes at the bottom, and every level knows its floor.

target-language.prompt: A decoder tower stepping a dense scrambled transmission down through cleaner and simpler stages, the signal emerging clear at street level without losing its meaning.
target-language.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the target-language modifier lineage.
target-language.bio: The tower does not water the message down. It gets it through the walls.

target-voice.prompt: A voice modulator rig held in a field of register bands, the selected band ringing bright and steady across its whole length.
target-voice.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the target-voice modifier lineage.
target-voice.bio: Same words, different frequency, different city. The rig picks one and holds it.

target-examples.prompt: A projector rig casting small vivid street-level scenes into the air beneath a large abstract looming shape, the miniatures sharp where the abstraction is vague.
target-examples.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the target-examples modifier lineage.
target-examples.bio: The big picture is fog until the projector shows one block of it at street level.

target-decisions.prompt: A control console of heavy switches, each one linked by a taut cable to the machinery it triggers further down the line.
target-decisions.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the target-decisions modifier lineage.
target-decisions.bio: Every switch does something downstream. The console exists so someone throws one.

target-stance.prompt: A stance dial set between a hot crimson pole and a cold blue pole, the needle locked firmly at a chosen point and the chosen temperature washing the scene.
target-stance.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the target-stance modifier lineage.
target-stance.bio: Encouraging or unflinching is a setting, not a mood. The dial is set on purpose.

executive-summary.prompt: A command table where a mountain of case files has been distilled to one decision slab hovering at eye level under a spotlight, the source stack receding into darkness behind it.
executive-summary.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Executive summary archetype.
executive-summary.bio: Command reads one slab before the sirens stop. It had better be the right slab.

creative-concept.prompt: A concept chamber with a luminous idea suspended in the shaping field, growing structure and a hard bright hook at its core while rough offcuts drift away.
creative-concept.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Creative concept archetype.
creative-concept.bio: Every big idea starts as loose energy. This is where it gets a silhouette.

note-taker.prompt: A capture rig turning a chaotic incoming stream of fragments into neat ordered plates that stack themselves into a clean archive rack.
note-taker.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Note taker archetype.
note-taker.bio: While everyone watches the fight, something has to watch the facts.

message-email.prompt: A comms relay composing one sealed transmission capsule, its tone-tuning ring glowing at the chosen register, ready to launch into the dark channel.
message-email.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Message & email archetype.
message-email.bio: The message is short, the tone is chosen, and it lands before the news does.

prompt-improver.prompt: A workbench where an old directive core has been stripped down and rebuilt sharper, the discarded ambiguous parts laid out dark to one side.
prompt-improver.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Prompt improver archetype.
prompt-improver.bio: Same mission, cleaner orders. The parts that got sidekicks confused are on the bench.

learning-guide.prompt: A training hologram with a central idea at its heart and a guided path of illuminated waypoints circling it, worked examples orbiting close.
learning-guide.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Learning guide archetype.
learning-guide.bio: Every cadet orbits the same idea until it clicks. The path is the syllabus.

app-build-handoff.prompt: A sealed mission capsule holding a complete self-contained plan, every layer visible through its casing, locked into a robot sidekick's chest dock and ready to run without a handler.
app-build-handoff.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the App build handoff archetype.
app-build-handoff.bio: The builder never phones home. Everything it needs is in the capsule or it fails.

agent-skill.prompt: A utility-belt cartridge snapped onto a bandolier rail, its trigger face lit, procedure grooves and guardrail clamps visible along its casing.
agent-skill.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Agent skill archetype.
agent-skill.bio: Snap it into any suit: it knows its trigger, its steps, and its hard limits.

agent-gate.prompt: A judgment gate arch scanning a device passing beneath it, a hard scanning plane sweeping the object and a verdict light holding at the top of the arch.
agent-gate.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Agent gate archetype.
agent-gate.bio: The gate has no friends. That is exactly why the team trusts what it clears.

social-post.prompt: A rooftop signal rig fitted with several interchangeable beacon heads, one selected and raised, its shaped burst already rolling out over the night skyline.
social-post.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Social post archetype.
social-post.bio: One story, five frequencies. The pod shapes the signal for whoever is listening.

quick-explanation.prompt: A compact signal watch held up alone, one clear steady beam, nothing around it and nothing between the viewer and the point.
quick-explanation.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Quick explanation archetype.
quick-explanation.bio: No origin story, no montage. Just the answer, lit.

research-brief.prompt: A balanced dossier suspended between two evidence pillars, confidence bands rendered as visible width around each finding, the uncertain ones deliberately wider.
research-brief.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Research brief archetype.
research-brief.bio: The brief tells command what it knows and exactly how hard it knows it.

decision-advisor.prompt: A war-room weighing console with several mission options mounted on measured arms, one arm settling low and lighting hot as the recommendation commits.
decision-advisor.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Decision advisor archetype.
decision-advisor.bio: Options in, verdict out, trade-offs on the record. The cape is optional.

data-analysis.prompt: A black-box flight recorder cracked open, its contents fanning out into layered insight strata, one segment isolated and brought forward glowing.
data-analysis.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Data analysis archetype.
data-analysis.bio: The core remembers everything. The analysis remembers what mattered.

risk-premortem.prompt: A collapsed-bridge diorama on the planning table being read in reverse, luminous failure lines running backward from the wreck to the small quiet bolt that started it.
risk-premortem.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Risk premortem archetype.
risk-premortem.bio: Run the disaster before it runs you. The tiny cause is always embarrassing.

writing-draft.prompt: A story loom weaving a first continuous draft out of raw fiber, the fabric clean but still on the frame, edges deliberately unfinished.
writing-draft.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Writing draft archetype.
writing-draft.bio: First drafts are supposed to have loose threads. Finished is a different issue.

rewrite-polish.prompt: A suit-finishing wheel refining an existing armor piece, dull surface lifting away under the buffer to reveal the same form underneath, sharper and brighter.
rewrite-polish.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Rewrite & polish archetype.
rewrite-polish.bio: Same story, same spine, all shine. The lathe removes; it never invents.

critique-review.prompt: An inspection bay with a device held in restraints, prioritized flag-markers planted along it, the most serious one burning hottest.
critique-review.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Critique & review archetype.
critique-review.bio: Every flaw gets a flag. Only one gets the hot flag. Start there.

presentation-outline.prompt: A run of floating briefing screens receding in sequence across the war room, each holding one clear shape, a bright throughline connecting them front to back.
presentation-outline.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Presentation outline archetype.
presentation-outline.bio: The pitch lands panel by panel, and the line through them never breaks.

build-plan.prompt: A headquarters tower rising in ordered construction stages with milestone beacons locked at each level, dependency cables drawn taut between them.
build-plan.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Project plan archetype.
build-plan.bio: The tower goes up in stages, and every stage knows exactly whose signal it waits on.

spec-prd.prompt: A contract vault with requirement plates bolted around its core, each plate seated and sealed, tolerances etched as clean grooves in the armor plating.
spec-prd.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Spec / PRD archetype.
spec-prd.bio: The build argues with nobody. It argues with the plates, and the plates win.

coding.prompt: An auto-forge in the hero's lab assembling a working gadget piece by piece, structure knitting into place under the arm, test probes already tapping the finished edge.
coding.alt: Superhero illustration asset for the Code implementation archetype.
coding.bio: Built and tested in the same breath. The probes never wait for a demo.
